## New entry

- New file (`catalog/<category>/<slug>.json`):
- Entry slug:

## Checklist

- [ ] Entry has `slug`, `name`, `description`, `url`, `tags`
- [ ] `slug` is unique in its file
- [ ] `url` is `http(s)` and points at the tool's home
- [ ] Searched the catalog — not a duplicate
- [ ] `npm run validate:data` passes
